ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,

input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, since Deliverables such as configurations and integrations are software work product and our position is a 12-month conformance period for software (90 days for services). If a shorter period is essential we can accept ninety (90) days, provided the numeral is stated expressly and the remedy in 19.4 is unchanged.
input.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty period in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months.
